content.text: {"narrative":[{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $9.326 billion in 2022, flagged as a figure to watch.","cites":["kpi:188"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $8.920 billion in 2023 and $8.263 billion in 2024.","cites":["kpi:189","kpi:182"]},{"claim":"In 2024 UNICEF's Core Resources income was $1.584 billion, which was 46% of total income.","cites":["kpi:177","kpi:183"]},{"claim":"Within 2024 Core Resources income, UNICEF's private sector contributed $724.9 million, the public sector $512.6 million and other partners $346.1 million.","cites":["kpi:179","kpi:178","kpi:180"]},{"claim":"In 2024, Other Resources Regular made up 49% of UNICEF's total income, while Other Resources Emergency made up 5%.","cites":["kpi:184","kpi:185"]},{"claim":"In India in 2024, safely managed water supplies were provided to 59.3 million people and sanitation services to 17.9 million people.","cites":["kpi:198","kpi:199"]}]}
